title: Certify uncovered-pivot roots and 90 enlarged-mask costs (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope
No new κ. Construct the even-L root and correct one excess physical idle incidence in #6868's proxy. All 90 specified L18/pivot8 enlargements lose at κ=.00337180, with no reentry through .01 under the fixed-word, unchanged-native, whole-idle contract. Frames must be data-independent or nondegenerate at D=1,S=-1.

## Task and sources
Base 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a. #6868: 5a4f80eda5c5c504531019ad44b5ed48c1cee480; #6833: 51f54e3c31f2f3a3e056a483b3ed66ae916ad06a. Distinct from #6858.

## Validation
`python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-uncovered-pivot-root`
Expected: PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE. Eight registered checks, independent geometry/pricing, normal/-O and read-only exports passed. Controls reject missing thin/pivot terms, corrupt inputs and infeasible prices. Complete remote tree matches tested files.

## Limitations and credit
All five assumptions remain. Optimistic covers need not be attainable; other masks, dense duals and changed words remain open. No native/compiler admission. Full-history preflight unrun on shallow checkout. @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance and separate review; credit DreamingOfClouds, Ali Romman and retained lineage.

[Proofs, exact byte pins, receipts and remaining questions](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/980b3d10e259fc99db1fa661fe431ae1a2a33dc4/research/p104-uncovered-pivot-root).
